comment: Planted runs for the long-lived worker eval. 'early' runs open the journal, 'middle' sits halfway, 'late' closes it; filler runs fill the gaps. Emails are written compactly and expanded to full search results by dataset.py.

early.request: Start on my Denver trip for the Acme offsite, Nov 12-15. For flights I always want an aisle seat, and keep hotels under $250 a night. Find the flight booking.

result.subject: eTicket Itinerary and Receipt for UA 1482
result.text: Thank you for choosing United. Flight UA 1482, San Francisco (SFO) to Denver (DEN), Thursday, November 12, 2026. MileagePlus member: please review your trip details below and keep this receipt for your records. Fare rules: changes permitted for a fee; basic economy fares are not eligible for changes. Baggage: first checked bag $40, second $50. Travel documents: a REAL ID-compliant license or passport is required for domestic travel starting May 2025. Departs SFO 7:05 AM, arrives DEN 10:38 AM. Seat 14C. Confirmation code: QX7R2P. Total charged to Visa ending 4417: $312.40.

early.response: Found the United booking: UA 1482 SFO to DEN on Nov 12. Noted your preferences: aisle seats, hotels under $250/night.
